articles.title: Pune airport to launch daily direct flight to Bhubaneswar from October 25 - Mid-Day
articles.full_text:
Pune airport to launch daily direct flight to Bhubaneswar from October 25
Pune airport will have a daily direct IndiGo flight to Bhubaneswar from October 25, coinciding with the Winter Schedule 2026–27. Airlines have taken up 216 of the 235 available daily slots, strengthening the city’s domestic air connectivity
The new Pune–Bhubaneswar service will connect Pune, a major industrial and IT hub in Maharashtra, with the Odisha capital, which is an important centre for administration, education, industry and tourism. FILE PIC
Pune Airport will strengthen its domestic air connectivity with the introduction of a daily direct flight to Bhubaneswar by IndiGo from Sunday, October 25, coinciding with the commencement of the Winter Schedule 2026–27 approved by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
Under the new winter schedule, airlines have taken up 216 of the 235 available daily slots at Pune Airport for flight operations across various routes, reflecting the demand for air travel to and from the city.
